tankmate.notes: Your two propane warnings are here — Switchover Warning when the feeding tank runs low, and Critical Backup when the reserve drops under half. Each has its own sound switch in Settings.

batterybuddy.notes: Freezing and Heat alarms can now be silenced one at a time — a silenced alarm still shows on screen, it just makes no sound. Your saved banks carry over.

solarbuddy.notes: A tidy-up release: the version on the About line is the true version, Check for updates opens the real updates page in your browser, and the footer now carries our full name — Off Grid Buddy Solutions.

buddyboard.notes: Buddy Board now opens with any two Buddy apps — Water Buddy counts. Propane shows your two true warnings, Switchover Warning and Critical Backup, each with its own sound switch.

offgridbuddy.notes: The update checker now tells the truth about its own version, and the Dash & Alarms list carries both propane warnings — Switchover Warning and Critical Backup. Your dash choices carry over.

waterbuddy.notes: Words fixed to match the real thing: the heater runs on 12-volt DC power — from a battery with an inline fuse, or a plug-in supply that feeds the DC input. Water Buddy itself never touches house power.

buddytech.notes: A tidy-up release: the version on the About line is the true version, Open updates page opens the real updates page in your browser, and the footer now carries our full name — Off Grid Buddy Solutions.

buddyboardlite.notes: A tidy-up release: the version shown is the true version, the Updates button opens the real updates page in your browser, and our full name — Off Grid Buddy Solutions — is on the page.
